items.audioText:
During the preflight check, the co-pilot noticed hydraulic fluid near the landing gear bay without discovering any leak.
Question: Where did the copilot find the leak of fluid?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行前检查期间，副驾驶注意到起落架舱附近有液压油，但没有发现任何泄漏点。问题：副驾驶在哪里发现了液压油？

items.audioText:
The modern radar systems are so sensitive that they allow the pilots to land completely blind in perfect safety.
Question: Why can the pilot make a completely blind landing?
items.audioTextZh: 现代雷达系统十分灵敏，使飞行员能够在完全没有目视参照的情况下安全着陆。问题：飞行员为什么能够实施完全盲降？

items.audioText:
M1: Could you check with Shanghai Center to give us a higher altitude? We need to get out of turbulence. M2: OK, I will contact the controller to see if they can give us FL350.
Question: Why does the flight crew want to change altitude?
items.audioTextZh: 男1：你能否向上海区调询问，给我们一个更高的高度？我们需要脱离颠簸区。男2：好的，我会联系管制员，看能否给我们FL350。问题：机组为什么想改变高度？

items.audioText:
The airspeed indicator, altimeter and vertical speed indicator all use static pressure, but only the airspeed indicator uses pitot pressure.
Question: Which of the following uses both static and pitot pressure?
items.audioTextZh: 空速表、高度表和升降速度表都使用静压，但只有空速表还使用皮托管压力。问题：以下哪种仪表同时使用静压和皮托管压力？

items.audioText:
Before flight preparation, the flight crew should give careful thought to make sure endurance and fuel reserves are well above the minima required by the regulation.
Question: Before flight preparation, what should the flight crew consider?
items.audioTextZh: 进行飞行准备时，机组应认真考虑，确保续航能力和燃油储备充分高于法规要求的最低标准。问题：飞行准备时，机组应考虑什么？

items.audioText:
Sometimes the controller may provide weather avoidance clearance to the pilots; such clearance always contains the direction and distance.
Question: What will be contained in an avoidance clearance?
items.audioTextZh: 有时，管制员会向飞行员发布绕飞天气许可；此类许可总会包含方向和距离。问题：绕飞许可中包含什么？

items.audioText:
It is essential for the pilot to maintain a listening watch on the proper frequency, as the departure time may be revised.
Question: What should the pilot do?
items.audioTextZh: 由于离场时间可能调整，飞行员必须在正确的频率上持续守听。问题：飞行员应该怎么做？

items.audioText:
In preflight planning, an accurate estimate of time en route must be made to establish fuel requirements for the flight.
Question: Why must accurate en route time be calculated?
items.audioTextZh: 进行飞行前计划时，必须准确估算航路飞行时间，以确定该航班的燃油需求。问题：为什么必须准确计算航路飞行时间？

items.audioText:
An RJ is cleared to line up and be ready for immediate takeoff following a departing B747, and incoming traffic is on short final. Wind conditions are calm, and the weather is dry and clear.
Question: Why is the departing traffic important to the captain of the RJ?
items.audioTextZh: 一架支线客机获准进跑道对正，并准备在一架离场B747之后立即起飞；进场航空器正在短五边。当前静风，天气干燥晴朗。问题：为什么前方离场航空器对这架支线客机的机长很重要？

items.audioText:
When the pilot hears a resolution advisory (RA), he is only 30 seconds away from collision, so there isn't enough time to advise ATC. The first priority is to take action.
Question: What's the first thing a pilot should do after getting an RA?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员收到决断咨询（RA）时，距离可能相撞只剩约30秒，因此没有足够时间先通知空中交通管制，首要任务是立即采取避让行动。问题：飞行员收到RA后首先应该做什么？

items.audioText:
P: Xi'an Control, CES2512, TCAS descent completed, 7800m resumed.
Question: What does the pilot mean?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：西安区调，CES2512，TCAS下降机动已完成，已恢复7800米。问题：飞行员是什么意思？

items.audioText:
B: The training of the flight crew uses normal procedures to ensure the airplane condition is acceptable for flight.
Question: What is not the function of normal procedures?
items.audioTextZh: 说话人：飞行机组训练使用正常程序，以确保飞机状态适合飞行。问题：以下哪项不是正常程序的功能？

items.audioText:
B: Highest features in the vicinity of each flight leg will be far below the designed altitude and away from the line of flight.
Question: What does the sentence mean?
items.audioTextZh: 说话人：每个航段附近的最高地形或障碍物都应远低于设计飞行高度，并远离飞行航迹。问题：这句话是什么意思？

items.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CSN345. C: CSN345, go ahead. P: There seems to be a bush fire just to the right of our position, about 40 miles. C: Can you give us the exact position, please? P: Stand by, we are 25 miles from LKO VOR on the 150 radial. C: Position copied, thank you, CSN345.
Question: Why did Wuhan Control want China Southern 345's exact position?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉区调，CSN345。管制员：CSN345，请讲。飞行员：我们当前位置右侧约40海里处似乎有一场灌木火灾。管制员：请提供准确位置。飞行员：稍等，我们位于LKO VOR台150度径向线、距台25海里处。管制员：位置已收到，谢谢，CSN345。问题：武汉区调为什么需要CSN345提供准确位置？

items.audioText:
P: Chengdu Control, CSN4971, we are unable to control the pressurization, cabin altitude is rising fast, request immediate descent to 3000m. C: CSN4971, descend to 3000m, report reaching. P: Descending to 3000m, report reaching, CSN4971.
Question: What was the crew's initial maneuver?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：成都区调，CSN4971，我们无法控制增压，座舱高度正在快速上升，请求立即下降至3000米。管制员：CSN4971，下降至3000米，到达时报告。飞行员：下降至3000米，到达时报告，CSN4971。问题：机组最初采取了什么机动？

items.audioText:
P: London Control, BAW403, we lost pitch control. We need a very long final. Request fire service assistance upon landing, position 14 miles from threshold, 4000ft, heading 250. C: BAW403, London, continue this heading for the moment. We will position you to a long straight-in approach in a few minutes.
Question: What did the pilot request?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：伦敦管制，BAW403，我们失去了俯仰操纵能力，需要一个很长的最后进近。请求着陆时提供消防救援。当前位置距跑道入口14海里，高度4000英尺，航向250。管制员：BAW403，伦敦管制，暂时保持此航向，几分钟后我们将引导你建立长距离直线进近。问题：飞行员提出了什么请求？

items.audioText:
C: BAW639, turn left heading 130 to offset your original track. The latest weather forecast reports CBs are prevailing on your route. Fly with caution. After going around them, resume own navigation. P: Turn left heading 130 to detour CBs, BAW639.
Question: What does the controller's instruction to BAW639 indicate?
items.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW639，左转航向130，偏离原航迹。最新天气预报显示你的航路上有多处积雨云。谨慎飞行，绕过积雨云后恢复自主领航。飞行员：左转航向130绕飞积雨云，BAW639。问题：管制员对BAW639的指令说明了什么？

items.audioText:
P: Tianjin Ground, CCA410, Stand 203, information J, request ATC clearance. C: CCA410, cleared to Shanghai via flight planned route, follow ANRAT 2D, initial climb to 1200m, after departure contact 127.9, squawk 5345.
Question: What is the SID and transponder code?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：天津地面，CCA410，203号停机位，收到通播J，请求放行许可。管制员：CCA410，许可按计划航路飞往上海，执行ANRAT 2D离场，初始爬升至1200米，离场后联系127.9，应答机编码5345。问题：标准仪表离场程序和应答机编码分别是什么？

items.audioText:
P: ACA767, request climb to FL360 due to turbulence. C: ACA767, FL360 is not available due to spacing. Can you accept FL380? P: Negative due to weight, but we need to change level. A lower level is OK, ACA767. C: ACA767, descend to FL300.
Question: Why could Air Canada 767 not accept FL380?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：ACA767，由于颠簸，请求爬升至FL360。管制员：ACA767，由于间隔原因，FL360不可用。能否接受FL380？飞行员：不能，由于重量原因无法接受，但我们需要改变高度，较低高度也可以，ACA767。管制员：ACA767，下降至FL300。问题：ACA767为什么不能接受FL380？

items.audioText:
P: UAL342, encountering severe icing at altitude 5400m, what altitude do you recommend? C: UAL342, we have several pilot reports which say 4200m is clear of ice. P: We will request descent to 4200m, UAL342.
Question: Where did the controller get the information for the no-ice level?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：UAL342，在5400米高度遭遇严重结冰，你建议使用什么高度？管制员：UAL342，我们收到多份飞行员报告，称4200米没有结冰。飞行员：我们请求下降至4200米，UAL342。问题：管制员从哪里获得无结冰高度的信息？

items.audioText:
C: CSN3309, Beijing Control, if you read, squawk ident. C: CSN3309, squawk ident observed, check your transmitter, I read you 1. C: CSN3309, turn right 090, descend to 5400m on standard, we will continue radar control, I read you 1.
Question: What problem does CSN3309 have?
items.audioTextZh: 管制员：CSN3309，北京区调，如果能听到，请按应答机识别键。管制员：CSN3309，已观察到识别信号，检查你的发射机，我听你信号强度为1。管制员：CSN3309，右转航向090，按标准气压下降至5400米，我们将继续实施雷达管制，我听你信号强度为1。问题：CSN3309出现了什么问题？

items.audioText:
P: ACA16, we need to descend to 2500m immediately due to a pressurization problem. C: ACA16, we can't descend you due to high ground. For descent, turn right 020 degrees, then cleared to descend to 2000m at your discretion on 29.1 QNH.
Question: What do they have to do before they can descend?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：ACA16，由于增压故障，我们需要立即下降至2500米。管制员：ACA16，由于前方地形较高，目前无法许可你下降。如需下降，先右转航向020度，随后可自行决定下降至2000米，QNH 29.1。问题：他们在下降前必须先做什么？

items.audioText:
P: Tower, CCA710, approaching taxiway 23. C: CCA710, good evening, taxi to runway 07L via runway 07R, backtrack 07R to taxiway 11. P: Confirm taxi straight ahead, CCA710. C: CCA710, negative, turn left, backtrack runway 07R to taxiway 11.
Question: How are they going to get to taxiway 11?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：塔台，CCA710，正在接近23号滑行道。管制员：CCA710，晚上好，经07R跑道滑往07L跑道，在07R跑道反向滑行至11号滑行道。飞行员：请确认径直滑行，CCA710。管制员：CCA710，不是，左转，在07R跑道反向滑行至11号滑行道。问题：他们将如何到达11号滑行道？

items.audioText:
P: NWA968, waiting at holding point 29, request return to the stand, the brakes are overheating. C: Roger, NWA968, return to the holding bay, first convenient turn left onto taxiway J. P: Left turn onto taxiway J, NWA968.
Question: Which taxiway is Northwest 968 to use?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：NWA968，在29号等待点等待，由于刹车过热，请求返回停机位。管制员：收到，NWA968，返回等待坪，在第一个合适路口左转进入J滑行道。飞行员：左转进入J滑行道，NWA968。问题：NWA968将使用哪条滑行道？

items.audioText:
C: CSN330, Beijing Control, radio check. You did not report over LADEX as instructed. CSN330, Beijing Control. CSN330, if you copy, squawk ident. CSN330, transmitting on 121.5.
Question: What is happening between the air traffic controller and the pilot?
items.audioTextZh: 管制员：CSN330，北京区调，无线电检查。你飞越LADEX时没有按指令报告。CSN330，北京区调。CSN330，如能听到，请按应答机识别键。CSN330，正在121.5频率上发射。问题：空中交通管制员与飞行员之间发生了什么？

items.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN3251, request taxi. C: CSN3251, for your information, KAL236 and CCA9018, both B747s, nearly collided on runway 14R one minute ago. Stay there now, I will call you back. P: Roger, CSN3251.
Question: What happened?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：地面，CSN3251，请求滑行。管制员：CSN3251，提醒你，一分钟前KAL236和CCA9018两架B747在14R跑道险些相撞。现在原地等待，我会再呼叫你。飞行员：收到，CSN3251。问题：发生了什么？

items.audioText:
P: Manchester Ground, United94, we have a hydraulic problem, we have lost nose wheel steering, we have to hold position and request a tug to take us back to the gate. C: Roger, United94, stand by. C: United94, suggest you shut down the engine, there is a tug for the flight. P: United94, roger.
Question: What problem does United94 have?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：曼彻斯特地面，United94，我们出现液压故障，失去了前轮转向能力，必须在当前位置等待，并请求派牵引车把我们拖回登机口。管制员：收到，United94，稍等。管制员：United94，建议关闭发动机，牵引车已经前来。飞行员：United94，收到。问题：United94出现了什么问题？

items.audioText:
P: UAL342, approaching the gate. C: UAL342, hold where you are. All passengers have to stay on board. It is reported that there was bird flu at your departure airport.
Question: What was the reason that the passengers were not allowed to disembark?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：UAL342，正在接近登机口。管制员：UAL342，在当前位置等待。所有乘客必须留在机上，据报告你们的起飞机场出现了禽流感。问题：为什么不允许乘客下机？

items.audioText:
P: Qantas235, hold on taxiway A. C: Qantas235, hold short for departure, you are Number 2 after Airbus320. P: Holding short, Number 2 for departure, Qantas235. C: Qantas235, line up and wait. P: Line up and wait, Qantas235.
Question: What was the departure sequence for Qantas235?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Qantas235，在A滑行道等待。管制员：Qantas235，在跑道外等待离场，你排在空客A320之后，为第二个离场。飞行员：在跑道外等待，第二个离场，Qantas235。管制员：Qantas235，进跑道对正并等待。飞行员：进跑道对正并等待，Qantas235。问题：Qantas235的离场顺序是什么？

items.audioText:
C: AFR201, have you reduced to approach speed? You are gaining on the aircraft ahead of you. P: AFR201, unable to reduce speed, we have a problem with flaps. C: AFR201, go around immediately, turn left heading 140, climb and maintain 4000ft for resequence ILS runway 23L.
Question: Why can't they reduce to approach speed?
items.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR201，你是否已减至进近速度？你正在接近前方航空器。飞行员：AFR201，无法减速，我们的襟翼有故障。管制员：AFR201，立即复飞，左转航向140，爬升并保持4000英尺，重新排序后对23L跑道实施ILS进近。问题：他们为什么无法减至进近速度？

items.audioText:
P: Chengdu Tower, good morning, SIA952, established on the ILS. C: SIA952, good morning, continue ILS approach runway 02. P: Continue, SIA952. C: SIA952, we have a report of a dog on the runway, so use caution during approach. You may receive a late clearance.
Question: Why did control advise caution to Singapore952?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：成都塔台，早上好，SIA952，已建立ILS。管制员：SIA952，早上好，继续对02号跑道实施ILS进近。飞行员：继续，SIA952。管制员：SIA952，我们收到跑道上有一条狗的报告，进近时请谨慎，着陆许可可能会较晚发布。问题：管制员为什么提醒SIA952谨慎进近？

items.audioText:
C: CCA4326, after departure, climb straight ahead until passing 1200m, then follow flight planned route. P: After departure, climb straight ahead until passing 1200m, then follow flight planned route, CCA4326. C: CCA4326, line up and wait. Vehicle crossing the upwind end of runway.
Question: Where is the vehicle?
items.audioTextZh: 管制员：CCA4326，离场后保持直线爬升，通过1200米后按计划航路飞行。飞行员：离场后保持直线爬升，通过1200米后按计划航路飞行，CCA4326。管制员：CCA4326，进跑道对正并等待，有车辆正在穿越跑道上风端。问题：车辆在哪里？

items.audioText:
P: Zhengzhou, CSN309, request descent, our anti-icing system is inoperative. C: CSN309, descend to 7000m. We had a pilot report one minute ago that there was moderate turbulence at 8000m over ZHO. P: Down to 7000m, thanks for your alert, CSN309.
Question: Why does the pilot request descent?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：郑州，CSN309，请求下降，我们的防冰系统失效。管制员：CSN309，下降至7000米。一分钟前有飞行员报告ZHO上空8000米有中度颠簸。飞行员：下降至7000米，谢谢提醒，CSN309。问题：飞行员为什么请求下降？

items.audioText:
P: CSN306, request 10 degrees heading change to the right of track to detour the CB. C: Roger, CSN306, turn right 10 degrees, heading 260. P: Right heading 260, CSN306. C: CSN306, clear of CB now, resume own navigation, report back on course.
Question: Which heading will be suitable for the aircraft to come back on track?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：CSN306，请求向航迹右侧改变航向10度，绕飞积雨云。管制员：收到，CSN306，右转10度，航向260。飞行员：右转航向260，CSN306。管制员：CSN306，现已避开积雨云，恢复自主领航，回到航路时报告。问题：飞机使用什么航向适合返回原航迹？

items.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN3108, I have to go back to the apron and need medical assistance upon arrival. The flight attendant reported a woman on board is miscarrying and needs a doctor. C: CSN3108, right turn ahead at intersection E5, we will inform those concerned.
Question: What happened on board?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：地面，CSN3108，我必须返回停机坪，并需要医疗人员接机。乘务员报告机上一名女性正在流产，需要医生。管制员：CSN3108，在前方E5交叉口右转，我们会通知相关单位。问题：机上发生了什么？

items.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, AFR966, intercepted a distress call from DLH124. DLH124 has a fuel emergency with 15 minutes endurance, requests landing priority. The aircraft position is 15 miles east, 9000ft. C: AFR966, roger MAYDAY, break, break.
Question: Which of the following statements is true?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，AFR966，截获了DLH124的遇险呼叫。DLH124发生燃油紧急情况，剩余续航时间15分钟，请求优先着陆。飞机位于以东15海里，高度9000英尺。管制员：AFR966，收到MAYDAY，各台注意。问题：以下哪项说法正确？

items.audioText:
P: Tower, AFR973, we rejected takeoff because red lights on the panel came on before V1. Request vacating the runway immediately, the warning is still on. C: AFR973, via first convenient intersection. Taxi via B6 to Number 2 apron.
Question: What reason caused AFR973 to abort takeoff?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：塔台，AFR973，V1前仪表板上的红色警告灯亮起，因此我们中断了起飞。请求立即脱离跑道，警告仍未消除。管制员：AFR973，从第一个合适的交叉口脱离，经B6滑往2号停机坪。问题：什么原因导致AFR973中断起飞？

items.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Control, AFR342, we lost pressurization, 9200m descending. C: AFR342, roger MAYDAY, break, break. All aircraft below 9200m between PB and MB immediately depart route A593 to the east due to emergency descent.
Question: What does Beijing Control instruct all aircraft between PB and MB to do?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京管制，AFR342，我们失去增压，正从9200米下降。管制员：AFR342，收到MAYDAY。各台注意，PB与MB之间9200米以下的所有航空器，因紧急下降立即向东脱离A593航路。问题：北京管制指示PB与MB之间的所有航空器做什么？

items.audioText:
P: Chengdu Control, CSN4971, we are unable to control the pressurization, cabin altitude is rising fast, request immediate descent to 3000m. C: CSN4971, descend to 3000m, report reaching. P: Descending to 3000m, report reaching, CSN4971.
Question: What was the crew's initial maneuver?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：成都管制，CSN4971，我们无法控制增压，座舱高度正在快速上升，请求立即下降至3000米。管制员：CSN4971，下降至3000米，到达时报告。飞行员：下降至3000米，到达时报告，CSN4971。问题：机组最初采取了什么机动？

items.audioText:
My best friend used to work for Thai Airways. He lived there for more than 10 years until he was offered a better job at Air France. Now he must decide whether he should take an even better job with Air China or stay in France. One problem is that he doesn't speak Chinese.
Question: Which statement is correct?
items.audioTextZh: 我最好的朋友以前在泰国航空工作。他在那里生活了十多年，后来获得法国航空提供的一份更好的工作。现在，他必须决定是接受中国国际航空一份更好的工作，还是留在法国。一个问题是他不会说中文。问题：以下哪项说法正确？

items.audioText:
A wingtip vortex is found during takeoff, cruise and landing. When the aircraft flies in ground effect, the ground interferes with the wingtip vortex, which reduces drag. When the aircraft is flying very near the ground, vortex strength is much less; therefore, there is a large reduction in drag.
Question: What's the main topic of the statement?
items.audioTextZh: 飞机在起飞、巡航和着陆阶段都会产生翼尖涡流。当飞机在地面效应范围内飞行时，地面会干扰翼尖涡流，从而减小阻力。飞机非常接近地面时，涡流强度明显减弱，因此阻力大幅降低。问题：这段陈述的主题是什么？

items.audioText:
AFR145 is currently en route from Paris to London Heathrow. The aircraft is descending to 3000ft and requests diversion to TLA. ATC is unable to grant the request due to conflicting traffic at 3000ft.
Question: Why did Air Traffic Control deny the request of Air France145?
items.audioTextZh: AFR145目前正在从巴黎飞往伦敦希思罗的航路上。飞机正下降至3000英尺，并请求备降TLA。由于3000英尺处有冲突航空器，空中交通管制无法批准该请求。问题：空中交通管制为什么拒绝AFR145的请求？

items.audioText:
A bomb threat closed the larger airport, so many aircraft were diverted to a smaller airport about an hour away. Because of the large number of diverted aircraft, the taxiways of the smaller airport were blocked. As a result, planes had to taxi onto the single runway, taxi to the opposite side, turn around and take off.
Question: Why did aircraft have to use the active runway as a taxiway?
items.audioTextZh: 一场炸弹威胁导致较大的机场关闭，许多航空器因此备降到约一小时航程外的一座较小机场。由于备降航空器数量众多，小机场的滑行道被堵塞。结果，飞机只能进入唯一一条跑道，沿跑道滑到另一端，调头后起飞。问题：飞机为什么必须把正在使用的跑道当作滑行道？

items.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, BAW141, B747, we have total electrical failure, request emergency landing, currently 10km west of Taiyuan, passing 7800m, heading 120.
Question: What problem does BAW141 have?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，BAW141，B747，我们的电气系统全部失效，请求紧急着陆。目前位于太原以西10公里，正通过7800米，航向120。问题：BAW141出现了什么问题？

items.audioText:
There was a very scary accident on the flight to Hawaii. During takeoff, there was dense cloud but no thunder or lightning. About 20 seconds later, as the plane was climbing, there was a tremendous flash outside the plane and a large bang. Immediately, the engines throttled back and we leveled off. We looked out of the window and the engines were there and there was no fire.
Question: What probably caused the large bang?
items.audioTextZh: 飞往夏威夷的航班上发生了一起非常惊险的事件。起飞时有浓云，但没有雷声或闪电。大约20秒后，飞机爬升过程中，机外突然出现强烈闪光并传来一声巨响。发动机随即减小推力，飞机改平。我们向窗外查看，发动机仍在，也没有起火。问题：那声巨响最可能由什么引起？

items.audioText:
A runway strip including a precision approach runway shall extend laterally for a distance of at least 150 meters from the runway centerline for code number 3 or 4, and at least 75 meters for code number 1 or 2.
Question: How does the runway strip of a precision runway extend from the runway centerline?
items.audioTextZh: 包含精密进近跑道的升降带应从跑道中线向两侧延伸：代码编号3或4至少150米，代码编号1或2至少75米。问题：精密进近跑道的升降带应从跑道中线向外延伸多远？

items.audioText:
When the aircraft was at 2000ft, flaps were lowered from 30 to 40. After passing the middle marker, the airspeed was decreased to 140 knots. At two miles from touchdown, rate of descent varied at times only by 100ft. In the end, a perfect landing was made because of these conditions.
Question: What was the condition at 2 miles from touchdown?
items.audioTextZh: 飞机在2000英尺时，襟翼从30度放至40度。通过中指点标后，空速减至140节。在距接地点2海里处，下降率的波动一度只有100英尺。最终，在这些条件下完成了一次平稳着陆。问题：距接地点2海里时的情况如何？

items.audioText:
In serious emergency situations, pilots make a MAYDAY call requiring immediate assistance. In other urgent situations, pilots make a PAN PAN call. PAN means possible assistance needed. This is used when they are in an emergency but the danger does not threaten flight safety now. Pilots may request necessary steps to deal with the problem.
Question: What does the PAN PAN abbreviation P.A.N. mean?
items.audioTextZh: 在严重紧急情况下，飞行员呼叫MAYDAY，表示需要立即援助。在其他紧迫情况下，飞行员呼叫PAN PAN；PAN表示“可能需要援助”。它用于飞机处于紧急情况、但危险尚未立即威胁飞行安全时。飞行员可以请求采取必要措施处理问题。问题：PAN PAN中的P.A.N.代表什么？

items.audioText:
P: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN, AFR4095, B737, we have shut down Number 2 engine due to a bird strike. Heading now 320, altitude 600m, position 10 miles south of RTD, request return for immediate landing.
Question: Why was the engine shut down?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行员：PAN PAN，PAN PAN，PAN PAN，AFR4095，B737，由于遭遇鸟击，我们已经关闭2号发动机。当前航向320，高度600米，位于RTD以南10海里，请求立即返场着陆。问题：为什么关闭发动机？

items.audioText:
A flight director is found on the primary flight instruments as chevron indicators or a pair of vertical and horizontal bars. Both chevron and bar flight director indicators mean that by flying toward them, the pilot can regain or maintain the programmed flight path.
Question: What is the main topic in the statement?
items.audioTextZh: 飞行指引仪显示在主飞行仪表上，形式可以是人字形指示符，也可以是一对垂直和水平指令杆。无论人字形还是指令杆显示，飞行员只要操纵飞机朝指示方向飞行，就能重新截获或保持预设航迹。问题：这段陈述的主题是什么？

items.audioText:
Every aircraft in flight generates wake turbulence, which trails downstream from the wingtips, can be very dangerous and requires aircraft to maintain safe separation. When landing behind a larger aircraft, it is important to stay at or above that aircraft's final approach flight path and land beyond its touchdown point. This becomes extremely important in calm wind conditions.
Question: When landing behind a larger aircraft, in which condition is it especially important to stay at or above that aircraft's final approach flight path?
items.audioTextZh: 每架飞行中的航空器都会产生从翼尖向后延伸的尾流。尾流可能非常危险，因此航空器必须保持安全间隔。在大型航空器之后着陆时，应保持在其最后进近航迹或以上，并在其接地点之后接地；在静风条件下这一点尤其重要。问题：跟随大型航空器着陆时，在什么条件下尤其需要保持在其最后进近航迹或以上？

items.audioText:
P1: Did you hear what Captain Mike said? There was something about the date when the flight plan reports would be chosen. P2: Yes, he said we should hand in the flight plan report when we finished it, but they must be finished on or before November 13.
Question: When would the flight plan reports be given to the captain?
items.audioTextZh: 男1：你听到迈克机长说什么了吗？他说到了提交飞行计划报告的日期。男2：听到了。他说完成后就应上交飞行计划报告，但必须在11月13日或之前完成。问题：飞行计划报告什么时候交给机长？

items.audioText:
There are some basic common practices we need to follow when making radio calls, and an important one is to listen before you transmit. Keying the transmitter when someone is transmitting will jam the frequency. Remember, it is a party line. It is unprofessional and ineffective to step on communication between others.
Question: What is the man mainly talking about?
items.audioTextZh: 进行无线电通话时需要遵循一些基本惯例，其中重要的一条是发射前先守听。别人在发射时按下发射键会干扰频率。要记住，这是各台共用的频率；压住他人的通信既不专业，也没有效率。问题：这名男子主要在谈论什么？

items.audioText:
Weather information is very important, so pilots often receive weather updates. Updated weather information includes wind speed and direction. If the wind direction is changing, the direction is given as a range, such as variable from 150 to 210 degrees. This information is particularly important for takeoff and landing.
Question: Besides speed, what other information about wind is particularly important for takeoff and landing?
items.audioTextZh: 天气信息非常重要，因此飞行员经常接收最新天气。更新的天气信息包括风速和风向。如果风向不断变化，会以范围表示，例如在150度至210度之间变化。这类信息对起飞和着陆尤其重要。问题：除了风速，还有哪项风的信息对起飞和着陆特别重要？

items.audioText:
Mechanic: Captain, did you find a problem in the cockpit? Captain: Come here, look, the right chair is not movable. Mechanic: Let me have a check. Yes, the controls are a little tight. I am going to fix it; it won't take long. Captain: OK, the chair must be adjusted to a proper position to obtain the optimum eye reference position.
Question: Why should the chair be put in a proper position?
items.audioTextZh: 机务：机长，你发现驾驶舱里有什么问题吗？机长：过来看看，右座座椅无法移动。机务：让我检查一下。是的，操纵机构有点紧。我来修好，不会花很长时间。机长：好的，座椅必须调到合适位置，才能获得最佳目视参考位置。问题：为什么座椅必须调到合适位置？

items.audioText:
Last week, while we were preparing for pushback, I got a call from the purser that one of the passengers was yelling at other passengers. I immediately called for security to come aboard the aircraft and take the passenger off. The passenger was big and heavy, and there was quite a struggle.
Question: Why did security have to come onto the plane?
items.audioTextZh: 上周我们准备推出时，我接到乘务长电话，说有一名乘客正对其他乘客大喊大叫。我立即呼叫安保人员登机，将该乘客带下飞机。那名乘客身材高大、体重很重，带离过程相当费力。问题：安保人员为什么必须登机？

items.audioText:
The localizer transmitter is situated on the extended runway centerline beyond the stop end. The localizer is normally aligned with the runway centerline and extends course guidance along the descent path for 25 miles, with 45 ILS channels in the frequency range from 108.10 to 119.95MHz, to provide pilots with course guidance.
Question: What is the localizer used for?
items.audioTextZh: 航向台发射机位于跑道停止端之外的跑道中线延长线上。航向道通常与跑道中线对准，沿进近下降方向提供约25海里的航向引导；ILS共有45个相关频道，频率范围为108.10至119.95MHz，为飞行员提供航向引导。问题：航向道有什么用途？

items.audioText:
Conditions which require immediate corrective action by the flight crew are indicated by red warning lights located in the pilot's primary field of view. Conditions which require timely corrective action by the flight crew are indicated by amber caution lights. Blue lights do not need pilots' immediate action.
Question: Which lights require timely corrective action by the flight crew?
items.audioTextZh: 需要飞行机组立即采取纠正措施的情况，由位于飞行员主要视野内的红色警告灯指示；需要及时采取纠正措施的情况，由琥珀色注意灯指示。蓝色灯光不要求飞行员立即采取行动。问题：哪种灯光要求飞行机组及时采取纠正措施？

items.audioText:
Most radio carrier manufacturers have 360- or 720-channel capacity. A 360-channel radio uses 50kHz channel spacing, such as between 118.05 and 118.10. A 720-channel radio doubles the available frequencies by using 25kHz channel spacing.
Question: What spacing does a 360-channel radio have between channels?
items.audioTextZh: 大多数机载无线电具有360或720个频道。360频道无线电采用50kHz频道间隔，例如118.05与118.10之间；720频道无线电采用25kHz频道间隔，使可用频率数量增加一倍。问题：360频道无线电的频道间隔是多少？

items.audioText:
Good morning, ladies and gentlemen, from the flight deck. Welcome aboard Tristar Airlines Flight455 to St. Louis. We have leveled off and are cruising at 35000ft. We are turning off the fasten-seat-belt signs now, but for your safety, please keep your seat belts fastened while in your seat.
Question: Which of the following is Flight455 now doing?
items.audioTextZh: 女士们、先生们，早上好，这里是驾驶舱广播。欢迎乘坐三星航空455号航班前往圣路易斯。我们已经改平，正在35000英尺巡航。现在将关闭安全带指示灯，但为了安全，请在座位上时继续系好安全带。问题：455号航班目前正在做什么？

items.audioText:
RVR is runway visual range, which represents the range over which runway high-intensity lights can be seen in the direction of landing along the runway. RVR values are measured at three points along the runway: the touchdown point, midpoint and endpoint, also known as the stop end.
Question: At which runway point is RVR not measured?
items.audioTextZh: RVR是跑道视程，表示沿跑道着陆方向能够看见高强度跑道灯的距离。RVR数值在跑道沿线三个位置测量：接地点、中点和末端，末端也称停止端。问题：RVR不在哪个跑道位置测量？

items.audioText:
The passengers on a flight from Shanghai to Beijing were angry with the airline. About 20 minutes after takeoff, they had to turn back because the cabin temperature was very hot. The cabin crew had known about the air-conditioning problem even before takeoff and informed the captain, but he decided to take off anyway. After we returned to Beijing, the airline did not apologize or offer compensation for the delay, which was more than three hours.
Question: When was the captain informed of the problem?
items.audioTextZh: 一班从上海飞往北京的航班上，乘客对航空公司非常生气。起飞约20分钟后，由于客舱温度过高，飞机不得不返航。客舱机组在起飞前就知道空调存在问题，并通知了机长，但机长仍决定起飞。飞机返回北京后，航空公司没有为超过三小时的延误道歉或提供赔偿。问题：机长什么时候得知这一问题？
